subject: Car break-ins on my block
issue: Three cars on our block were broken into last month and nobody came out for the report until the next afternoon.
detail: We have called the non-emergency line about the same corner several times and each time the wait got longer.
ask: Please fund enough patrol officers that a break-in report gets a real response the same day.
actionable_reason: Concrete repeated problem with specific city action

subject: Slow response
issue: I waited almost three hours for an officer after someone smashed my car window in the carport.
ask: Please make sure the council funds more officers so response times come down.
actionable_reason: Specific delayed response; requests staffing funding

subject: Catalytic converter theft
issue: Someone cut the catalytic converter off our minivan in the driveway overnight, and the repair bill came to over two thousand dollars.
ask: Please put more patrol attention on overnight catalytic converter thefts in residential streets.
actionable_reason: Specific theft; requests targeted overnight patrols

subject: Street racing at night
issue: Every weekend after midnight cars race down the boulevard past our apartment and the noise wakes up the whole building.
ask: Please send patrols to enforce street racing at night and add speed humps where needed.
actionable_reason: Specific nightly racing; requests enforcement and traffic calming

subject: Robos de carros
issue: En mi cuadra han roto la ventana de tres carros en los últimos dos meses y nadie ha venido a tomar el reporte.
detail: Mi vecina esperó casi todo el día para que alguien llegara, y ya ni quiere llamar.
ask: Les pido que pongan más oficiales en patrullaje para que los robos se atiendan rápido.
actionable_reason: Robos repetidos en la cuadra; pide más patrullas

subject: Fireworks
issue: Illegal fireworks go off every night in the week before the holiday and I can't sleep with my baby.
ask: Please step up enforcement on illegal fireworks so families can get some rest.
actionable_reason: Specific nightly problem; requests enforcement

subject: Customer cars in our lot
issue: Customers keep leaving cars in our lot overnight and two of them have had catalytic converters cut off this year.
detail: We already added lighting and a fence, but the police said they cannot patrol the lot itself.
ask: Please assign more patrols to commercial lots at night so customers feel safe leaving their cars.
actionable_reason: Repeated theft at business lots; requests patrols

subject: Trộm xe
issue: Trong tháng này xe của gia đình tôi bị đập kính hai lần ngay trong con hẻm trước nhà.
detail: Tôi đã gọi số không khẩn cấp nhưng phải chờ hơn bốn tiếng, và cảnh sát chỉ ghi biên bản rồi về.
ask: Xin thành phố tăng thêm cảnh sát tuần tra ban đêm ở khu nhà chúng tôi.
actionable_reason: Trộm xe lặp lại; cần tuần tra

subject: Waited hours
issue: We waited close to four hours for an officer after a man broke into our neighbor's garage.
ask: Please fund faster patrol coverage so these calls are not left sitting for hours.
actionable_reason: Hours-long delay on a real break-in

subject: Officer funding in the budget
issue: I think the budget should fund more patrol officers, because right now a report can sit for a whole shift.
detail: My husband works nights and came home to find the tailgate of his truck pried open, and nobody came until morning.
We are tired of paying taxes and getting this kind of response.
ask: Please keep the officer hiring money in the budget and report back on how it will shorten response times.
actionable_reason: Budget officer hiring; specific response-time problem

subject: Falta de patrullas
issue: En el complejo donde vivo se han robado varios carros este año y la policía casi nunca pasa por la noche.
detail: Mi esposo maneja de noche y dice que no ha visto ni una patrulla en semanas.
ask: Les pido que aumenten las patrullas nocturnas y que el presupuesto apoye más oficiales.
actionable_reason: Robos de carros; pide patrullas nocturnas y presupuesto

subject: Against more officer money
issue: I do not think the city should keep adding to the police budget when the response times are already this bad.
detail: The problem in my view is how the department is run, and that should be looked at before any new hires.
ask: Please vote against the new officer hiring line until there is an audit of how the department spends its money.
actionable_reason: Requests audit before funding officer hiring

subject: Fireworks again
issue: Fireworks went off in the street until two in the morning again, and our dog hid under the bed all night.
ask: Please send an officer to fireworks complaints quickly, because by the time anyone comes they are gone.
actionable_reason: Repeat fireworks; slow enforcement response

subject: Nakaw ng sasakyan
issue: Dalawang beses nang sinira ang bintana ng kotse namin sa harap ng bahay ngayong taon.
detail: Tumawag na kami sa hindi emergency na numero pero hindi pa rin dumating ang pulis hanggang kinabukasan.
ask: Sana po ay dagdagan ng konseho ang bilang ng pulis na nagro-roonda sa gabi.
actionable_reason: Paulit-ulit na pagnanakaw; kulang na pagroronda

subject: Break-ins in our lot
issue: My car was broken into twice in one month in our apartment lot and the police only came out once, after I called three times.
ask: Please prioritize repeat car break-in reports in the next budget and patrol plan.
actionable_reason: Repeated break-ins; requests prioritized patrol plan

subject: Sideshow noise
issue: Every Saturday night a group of cars does burnouts at the end of our cul-de-sac, and the smoke gets into our house.
ask: Please assign enforcement to sideshows and street racing in our area as a recurring problem.
actionable_reason: Recurring weekend sideshows; requests enforcement

subject: Delivery van break-in
issue: Someone broke into our delivery van in the lot overnight and took the handheld scanners and a case of tools.
detail: That van is our only one, so we lost three days of deliveries while the window was replaced.
ask: Please dedicate more patrols to commercial lots at night, since we pay taxes like everyone else.
actionable_reason: Business van theft; requests nighttime patrols

subject: Patrullas
issue: Los fuegos artificiales ilegales truenan hasta la madrugada y ya llamé varias veces sin que llegue nadie.
ask: Les pido que pongan más oficiales en esta zona para parar los fuegos artificiales.
actionable_reason: Fuegos ilegales repetidos; piden más oficiales

subject: Support the officer proposal
issue: I support the proposal to add more patrol officers in the budget, because our block watch has done what it can and we still get break-ins.
detail: Most of us are renters who cannot afford private cameras, so we rely on the city.
ask: Please approve the officer hiring line as proposed and track response times on a public dashboard.
actionable_reason: Supports officer hiring; wants public response data

subject: Pháo nổ
issue: Pháo nổ bất hợp pháp suốt đêm trước Tết và trẻ nhỏ trong nhà tôi sợ hãi, khóc không ngừng.
ask: Xin thành phố tăng cường xử phạt pháo nổ để các gia đình được yên ổn.
actionable_reason: Pháo nổ bất hợp pháp; cần xử phạt

subject: Oppose moving patrol money
issue: I oppose the proposal to move patrol money into a new unit, because our street still waits hours for an officer.
ask: Please vote no on that transfer until the department shows how response times will change.
actionable_reason: Opposes transfer; wants response-time plan first

subject: Who is actually assigned
issue: The police are talking about adding staff, but on my street they have not come by once this year, even though the cars keep getting broken into.
detail: I have a list of the incident numbers if anyone wants them.
ask: Please show us how many officers are actually assigned to our district before approving more money.
actionable_reason: Requests district officer assignment data before approving

subject: Negocio y robos
issue: Tengo una tienda de reparación de llantas y dos veces este año me robaron las herramientas de la parte de atrás.
detail: La policía tardó más de dos horas en venir ambas veces y después ya no quise llamar.
ask: Les pido que pongan más patrullas en las zonas comerciales por la noche.
actionable_reason: Robos repetidos en negocio; pide patrullas comerciales

subject: No patrols
issue: Nobody has come out to our complex in months, even though car windows keep getting smashed.
ask: Please fund more night patrols for our complex.
actionable_reason: Repeated car vandalism; no patrols for months

subject: Prevention over hiring
issue: I am against spending more on officers when we have not seen results from the current patrols on our street.
detail: My kids are scared of the crime, but I think money for after-school programs would do more than another round of hiring.
ask: Please redirect new public safety money to youth and prevention programs instead of new hires.
actionable_reason: Redirect public safety money to prevention programs

subject: Crisis team
issue: When my brother was in a mental health crisis last spring, the only option was calling police, and it turned into a scary situation for everyone.
ask: Please fund a crisis response team of mental health workers who can respond without officers for calls like this.
actionable_reason: Mental health crisis response without police needed

subject: Man on the sidewalk
issue: There is a man who sleeps near our apartment entrance and he is clearly having a breakdown most nights, but nobody comes who knows how to help him.
ask: Please send mental health outreach workers instead of police for calls like this.
actionable_reason: Outreach workers needed for crisis calls

subject: Crisis de salud mental
issue: Mi vecino que vive en la calle empezó a gritar y a empujar a la gente en la cuadra, y la policía llegó con las luces prendidas y lo asustó más.
detail: Creo que alguien que sepa de salud mental debió venir primero, porque él estaba muy enfermo y no era un criminal.
ask: Les pido que el presupuesto financie equipos de salud mental que respondan sin policías en llamadas como esta.
actionable_reason: Equipos de salud mental sin policías

subject: Civilian responders
issue: I think trained civilians should handle mental health crises instead of officers, because officers are not trained for them and it often goes badly.
detail: My neighbor's son was taken to jail after a psychotic episode and released a week later with no treatment.
The city already runs other social programs, so it can run this one too.
ask: Please fund a civilian crisis response program with clinicians and peer support workers and report on the first year.
actionable_reason: Civilian crisis program; reports results

subject: Doubts a civilian team
issue: I am not sure trained civilians can handle a crisis when someone has a weapon, so I would rather have officers stay part of the response.
detail: That is the situation I keep worrying about, especially with my kids walking home past the bus stop.
ask: Please keep officers in the lead on crisis calls and do not replace them with a pilot program until it is proven.
actionable_reason: Keep officers leading crisis calls until proven

subject: Unhoused neighbor
issue: Our block has a woman who yells at cars at night and I am worried she will get hurt, but calling police feels like making it worse.
ask: Please create a daytime outreach team that can check on people like her before a crisis happens.
actionable_reason: Preventive outreach needed before crises escalate

subject: Người vô gia cư
issue: Ở khu tôi có một người đàn ông vô gia cư bị khủng hoảng tinh thần, ông hay la hét giữa đường vào ban đêm.
detail: Cảnh sát đến rồi đi, không ai biết cách giúp ông ấy, và tôi rất lo cho sức khỏe của ông.
ask: Xin thành phố đưa nhân viên tâm thần đến hỗ trợ thay vì chỉ có cảnh sát.
actionable_reason: Cần nhân viên tâm thần hỗ trợ

subject: Customers in crisis
issue: Our coffee shop keeps getting customers in crisis who need help, and we are not trained for that.
detail: Last month a customer had a psychotic episode at the counter and I had to call police, which I hate doing.
ask: Please fund a mental health responder program that businesses can call instead of the police.
actionable_reason: Business needs mental health responders

subject: Opposing civilian pilot
issue: I oppose the proposed civilian crisis pilot because I don't trust that a new program will show up on time with enough staff at night.
ask: Please vote no on the pilot until the city shows funded staffing and a training plan.
actionable_reason: Wants staffing and training plan before pilot

subject: Llamadas de crisis
issue: Cuando mi mamá tuvo una crisis en casa, llamamos y tardaron horas, y nadie sabía cómo calmarla.
ask: Les pido que pongan un equipo de crisis que sepa manejar estas situaciones.
actionable_reason: Equipo de crisis capacitado; respuesta lenta

subject: Tired of the loop
issue: Our neighbor who is unhoused gets moved along by police every few weeks and returns to the same corner within a day.
ask: Please coordinate outreach so people get connected to services rather than just moved along.
actionable_reason: Connect unhoused neighbors to services

subject: Crisis counselors
issue: I think the city should hire more crisis counselors who work alongside police, so people do not end up in jail for having a bad day.
detail: My landlord called police on a tenant who was having a panic attack, and the situation got much worse.
A counselor would have done better.
ask: Please add crisis counselor positions to the public safety budget and report on how many calls they handle.
actionable_reason: Adds crisis counselors to public safety budget

subject: Send someone trained
issue: Please stop sending officers to every mental health call, because half the time the officer is not what the person needs.
ask: Send someone trained for this kind of call first and call police only if needed.
actionable_reason: Trained responders should lead mental health calls

subject: 心理危机
issue: 我住的地方附近有一位无家可归的人经常情绪失控，大声喊叫，有时候还会在路边摔东西。
detail: 我担心他会受伤，附近的孩子看到也会害怕，但叫警察又怕把事情弄得更糟。
ask: 希望市政府能派受过训练的心理危机人员去协助，而不是只派警察。
actionable_reason: 需要受过训练的心理危机人员

subject: Follow-up after crisis calls
issue: Someone in our building has been having episodes in the stairwell for months, and the ambulance comes but the only follow-up is a ride to the emergency room.
detail: Our building manager has asked for help several times, but nothing has changed.
ask: Please fund a follow-up team that connects people in crisis to a bed or a clinic after an emergency response.
actionable_reason: Follow-up care after crisis calls needed

subject: Cameras for safety
issue: I support using license plate readers on the main roads if they help catch the people who keep stealing catalytic converters from our cars.
detail: I would rather have a camera on the corner than an officer that never comes, and I accept some tracking for that.
ask: Please approve the license plate reader pilot and publish the rules on how long the data is kept.
actionable_reason: Approve LPR pilot with public data rules

subject: Privacy concern about readers
issue: I oppose license plate readers because they record where everyone drives, and I do not think a few stolen parts justify a database of our movements.
detail: Immigrant neighbors in my building already avoid going out after dark, and I don't want them to feel watched by their own city.
Any data kept should be deleted quickly and never shared with other agencies.
ask: Please vote against the plate reader contract unless there is a strict limit on data retention and sharing.
actionable_reason: Opposes plate readers without strict data limits

subject: Cámaras en la calle
issue: Estoy de acuerdo con poner cámaras en las calles principales si de verdad ayudan a encontrar a los que roban carros.
detail: Prefiero que haya una cámara que vigile la esquina a que nadie venga cuando hay un robo.
ask: Les pido que aprueben el programa de cámaras y que digan cuánto tiempo guardan las grabaciones.
actionable_reason: Aprobar cámaras con reglas claras de grabaciones

subject: No quiero que nos vigilen
issue: No quiero que nos vigilen con cámaras que leen las placas de nuestros carros, porque mucha gente aquí tiene miedo de ser rastreada.
ask: Les pido que no compren ese sistema sin garantías de que la información no se comparta con nadie.
actionable_reason: Rechazar lectores de placas sin garantías

subject: Cameras on corners
issue: We have had cameras on our corner for two years and they helped solve a hit and run.
ask: Please keep the current camera program and expand it to the blocks where thefts are most common.
actionable_reason: Expand corner cameras to high-theft blocks

subject: Store cameras and readers
issue: As a business owner I use cameras on my lot, but I am not sure a city-run plate reader adds much beyond what private systems already do.
detail: It seems like the money would be better spent on lighting and patrols at night than on a database that nobody reviews.
ask: Please ask for an independent review of plate readers before the city signs any contract.
actionable_reason: Requests independent review before contract signing

subject: Overreach concern
issue: I think city cameras in parks are an overreach, because they are going up where kids play and nobody asked us.
ask: Please require a public hearing before any new camera is installed in a park or on a school route.
actionable_reason: Requires public hearing before new cameras

subject: Mga camera sa kalsada
issue: Sa tingin ko makakatulong ang mga camera sa kalsada para mahuli ang mga magnanakaw ng sasakyan sa aming lugar.
detail: Pero sana may malinaw na patakaran kung gaano katagal itatago ang mga video at sino ang makakakita nito.
ask: Sana po ay magkaroon muna ng pampublikong pagdinig bago pumasok ang mga bagong camera sa aming kalye.
actionable_reason: Malinaw na patakaran sa pag-iimbak ng video

subject: Camera money
issue: I do not see how a camera on the corner stops a break-in when the police never show up.
ask: Please put the camera money toward patrol staffing instead.
actionable_reason: Redirect camera funds to patrol staffing

subject: Camera ở khu phố
issue: Tôi đồng ý lắp camera ở các góc đường đông người qua lại vì nhiều xe máy bị trộm.
detail: Nhưng tôi mong thành phố công khai ai được xem các đoạn video và trong bao lâu thì xóa.
ask: Xin hội đồng thành phố thông qua chương trình camera với quy định rõ ràng về việc lưu trữ dữ liệu.
actionable_reason: Thông qua camera kèm quy định lưu trữ

subject: Scanning everyone
issue: Scanning every car that drives past our house feels like the city is tracking us for no good reason.
ask: Please do not approve plate readers on residential streets.
actionable_reason: Bans plate readers on residential streets

subject: Cámaras y privacidad
issue: En mi cuadra ya hay cámaras de vecinos y no me molesta, pero no quiero que la ciudad guarde los videos durante años.
detail: Mi hijo trabaja en el turno de noche y lo último que quiero es que sus horarios queden en una base de datos.
ask: Les pido que pongan un límite claro de cuántos días se guardan las grabaciones antes de aprobar algo.
actionable_reason: Límite claro para guardar grabaciones

subject: After-school money
issue: Put the after-school program money back in the budget, because my son has nothing to do after school except hang around the corner store.
detail: A few of his friends got picked up by police last winter for loitering, which made everyone's parents nervous.
ask: Please keep the after-school program money in the budget and add late-night weekend hours.
actionable_reason: Keeps youth program budget; adds weekend hours

subject: Summer jobs
issue: Summer jobs for teens ran out before I could sign up my daughter, and she spent the whole summer at home.

actionable_reason: Earlier applications, more summer slots requested

subject: Path lights
issue: The lights on the path to the playground have been out for six months, and it is too dark for kids to walk home after practice.
ask: Please repair the path lighting and add it to the next capital improvement list.
actionable_reason: Broken path lights; repair requested

subject: Clases después de la escuela
issue: Mis hijos salen de la escuela a las tres y no tienen dónde estar hasta que yo llego del trabajo a las seis.
detail: Hay un programa de tarea que cerró el año pasado y no lo han vuelto a abrir.
ask: Les pido que financien un programa de tarea y actividades después de clases en nuestra zona.
actionable_reason: Programa después de clases; pide financiamiento

subject: Late night gym
issue: Our city gym closes at nine and teens have nowhere to go on Friday nights, so they end up in the parking lots.
ask: Please keep the gym open late on weekends as a funded pilot.
actionable_reason: Requests weekend late-night gym hours

subject: Restore youth funding
issue: I oppose the cut to youth programs in next year's budget, because these programs cost less than police overtime.
detail: A summer program kept my nephew off the streets, and I have seen the difference firsthand.
ask: Please restore the youth program funding before the budget is final.
actionable_reason: Restore youth program funding before budget

subject: Chương trình thiếu niên
issue: Con trai tôi ở nhà một mình đến tối vì không có chỗ nào cho các em sinh hoạt sau giờ học.
detail: Tôi mong thành phố mở lại lớp học thêm miễn phí vào mùa hè như mấy năm trước.
ask: Xin thành phố tiếp tục tài trợ các chương trình sinh hoạt cho thanh thiếu niên sau giờ học.
actionable_reason: Cần tài trợ sinh hoạt sau giờ học

subject: Youth over patrol
issue: I think the money should go to youth programs rather than patrols, because the teen center closed and the kids in my building have nowhere to go.
detail: My daughter is thirteen and spends the nights alone, and I work doubles so I cannot be there.
Programs that keep her busy would do more than any patrol car on our street.
ask: Please move part of the proposed patrol increase into late-night youth programs in the next budget.
actionable_reason: Shift patrol increase to youth programs

subject: Rec field evenings
issue: The city cut evening hours at the rec field this summer, so the kids who used to play soccer until dark are back on the street.
detail: The sign-up fees went up to cover rentals, and most families cannot afford it.
ask: Please restore the evening recreation hours and cover the costs with the existing youth budget.
actionable_reason: Restore evening recreation hours; cover costs

subject: Hiring teens
issue: I run a small landscaping business and I want to hire teens this summer, but the youth job placement paperwork is too slow.
detail: Two of the teens I interviewed had to drop out because the paperwork took six weeks.
ask: Please fast-track the summer youth job placement process for local small businesses.
actionable_reason: Speed up youth job placement paperwork

subject: Walking home
issue: Kids walking home from the library after dark have to cross a dark lot, and I'm worried about them every night.
ask: Please add lighting and a late bus route to help kids get home safely.
actionable_reason: Requests lighting and late bus route

subject: Muchachos en la calle
issue: Los muchachos de la cuadra andan en la calle hasta la madrugada porque no hay nada para ellos, y ya hubo una pelea grande.
detail: Yo sé que la mayoría son buenos chicos, pero les falta algo que hacer.
ask: Les pido que pongan un programa nocturno de deportes o clases para los jóvenes.
actionable_reason: Programa nocturno para jóvenes; falta de actividades

subject: Verano sin trabajo
issue: Mi hija quería un trabajo de verano y no pudo entrar en el programa porque se llenó en dos días.
ask: Les pido que abran más plazas de trabajo de verano para jóvenes el próximo año.
actionable_reason: Más plazas de verano para jóvenes

subject: Thanh niên không có chỗ đi
issue: Ở chung cư tôi, các em học sinh cấp hai không có chỗ học bài hay chơi sau giờ học nên cả tuần chỉ quanh quẩn ở sân.
detail: Mẹ tôi giữ bé ở nhà còn tôi phải đi làm ca tối, nên không ai để ý con em họ.
Tôi mong thành phố mở một phòng sinh hoạt có người lớn trông coi vào buổi tối.
ask: Xin thành phố mở chương trình sinh hoạt tối cho thiếu niên trong năm tới.
actionable_reason: Cần phòng sinh hoạt tối có người trông

subject: 孩子放学后
issue: 放学以后孩子没有地方去，晚上只能在街上闲逛，我很担心他们的安全。
ask: 希望市政府能增加夜间青少年活动项目，让孩子们有地方去。
actionable_reason: 增加夜间青少年活动项目

subject: Mentorship funding
issue: I support the budget item for youth mentorship, because a mentor on my son's team made a bigger difference than any patrol car could.
detail: Our city has a mentorship program that works, but it only has room for a few kids each year.
ask: Please keep youth mentorship funding in the budget and open it to more kids in our area.
actionable_reason: Keeps mentorship funding; expands enrollment

subject: Court lights
issue: The lights at the basketball courts shut off at nine, and kids who would be shooting hoops end up at the bus shelter with nothing to do.
detail: Parents in my building asked to keep them on until ten on weekends, and the request has been sitting for months.
ask: Please keep the court lights on until ten on weekends as a low-cost fix.
actionable_reason: Extend court lights to ten on weekends

subject: Priorities this year
issue: I oppose adding more police money this year, because the youth programs got cut and those kids are the ones getting into trouble.
detail: We have seen more kids on the street since the community pool closed for repairs and never reopened.
Give the money to after-school staff and counselors and see what changes in a year.
ask: Please vote no on the next officer hiring increase and move that money to youth programs.
actionable_reason: Votes no on officer hiring; funds youth programs

subject: Support limits on cooperation
issue: I support limiting how much local police work with federal immigration agents, because my neighbors stop calling for help when they fear a knock at the door.
detail: Two families on our street have already moved out after rumors that agents were in the area.
ask: Please pass the ordinance that keeps local officers out of civil immigration enforcement.
actionable_reason: Specific ordinance requested; ongoing enforcement fear

subject: Scared to call
issue: My mother won't call police anymore, even when someone breaks into the building, because she thinks they will check her papers.
ask: Please limit police cooperation with federal agents so people feel safe reporting crimes.
actionable_reason: Clear request on police-federal cooperation policy

subject: Miedo de llamar
issue: Mi familia tiene miedo de llamar a la policía desde que se corrió el rumor de que agentes federales andan por el barrio.
detail: Mi esposo maneja para trabajar y ya no quiere que salgamos a comprar nada de noche.
ask: Les pido que la policía local no ayude con redadas de inmigración y que lo dejen por escrito.
actionable_reason: Policía local sin ayudar a redadas

subject: Staff afraid to come in
issue: I run a restaurant and some of my cooks have stopped coming in because they are scared of being stopped on the way.
ask: Please adopt a policy limiting local police involvement in immigration enforcement.
actionable_reason: Policy needed; employees afraid to work

subject: Against the sanctuary idea
issue: I oppose limiting police cooperation with federal agents, because if someone is a criminal the police should be able to work with whoever can help.
ask: Please vote no on any policy that restricts officers from sharing information with federal partners.
actionable_reason: Vote no on restricting officer information sharing

subject: Both sides of the rule
issue: I oppose a blanket ban on working with federal partners, since the police need to be able to act on serious crimes in our area.
detail: I do not want neighbors harassed, but a blanket rule could block investigations into the robberies we keep having.
A narrow rule that targets civil immigration checks would make more sense to me.
ask: Please vote against a blanket ban and support narrower limits instead.
actionable_reason: Opposes blanket ban; proposes narrower limits

subject: Proteger a las familias
issue: Yo creo que la ciudad debe proteger a las familias inmigrantes, porque muchas tienen niños que van a la escuela y no quieren ver a la policía.
detail: Mi vecina dejó de mandar a su hija a la clase de música por miedo a que la detuvieran afuera.
Eso no debe pasar en nuestra ciudad.
ask: Les pido que aprueben un límite a la cooperación de la policía con agentes federales de inmigración.
actionable_reason: Aprobar límite a cooperación con agentes federales

subject: Write the rule down
issue: I am not sure what the right balance is, but I want the council to be clear about when local officers help with immigration arrests.
detail: Right now people hear different things from different officers, and that creates fear.
ask: Please publish a written policy that spells out when local police can assist federal immigration agents.
actionable_reason: Publish written policy on federal assistance

subject: Người nhập cư sợ hãi
issue: Gia đình tôi là người nhập cư, và chúng tôi rất sợ mỗi khi nghe tin cảnh sát hợp tác với đặc vụ liên bang.
detail: Con gái tôi không dám đi học một mình vì sợ bị hỏi giấy tờ, dù con không làm gì sai.
ask: Xin hội đồng thành phố hạn chế việc cảnh sát địa phương hỗ trợ đặc vụ liên bang bắt giữ người nhập cư.
actionable_reason: Cần hạn chế hợp tác với đặc vụ

subject: Sweeps ban
issue: I want the city to make it a rule that local officers do not join immigration sweeps in our area.
ask: Please pass a sweeps ban for local police so families are not caught up in federal operations.
actionable_reason: Ban local police joining immigration sweeps

subject: Sợ đi trình báo
issue: Một người bạn ở chung cư của tôi nhận được một lá thư có con dấu liên bang và không dám nói chuyện với cảnh sát khi xe bị trộm.
detail: Chị ấy vẫn chưa trình báo, và tôi nói chị ấy phải được trình báo mà không sợ hãi.
ask: Xin thành phố bảo đảm cảnh sát địa phương không hỏi về tình trạng nhập cư khi nhận tin báo.
actionable_reason: Cảnh sát không nên hỏi về nhập cư

subject: Cuadrilla de trabajo
issue: Tengo una empresa de jardinería con trabajadores inmigrantes y el mes pasado una de nuestras camionetas la detuvieron en un retén cerca de la carretera.
detail: Ese día perdimos un día completo de trabajo y uno de mis muchachos ya no quiere regresar.
ask: Les pido que aprueben una norma local que mantenga a la policía fuera de las redadas de inmigración.
actionable_reason: Norma local pedida tras retén a camioneta

subject: Against the sanctuary resolution
issue: I oppose a sanctuary policy that tells local officers to refuse federal requests, because it leaves our street exposed to people who should be arrested.
detail: Our block had a stolen car ring last year, and the federal task force was the only thing that helped us find them.
I would not want that tool removed.
ask: Please vote against the sanctuary resolution unless it keeps cooperation on serious criminal cases.
actionable_reason: Opposes resolution; keep criminal case cooperation

subject: Preguntas de papeles
issue: Cuando llamamos a la policía por un robo, lo primero que preguntan los oficiales es si tenemos papeles.
ask: Les pido que la policía de aquí no pregunte por el estatus migratorio al reportar un delito.
actionable_reason: Policía no debe preguntar estatus migratorio

subject: Hold a hearing
issue: I want the council to hold a public hearing on the policy before any vote, since the first draft was written without anyone from our community.
detail: Immigrant business owners on my street weren't invited to the first meeting, and I think that's a problem.
ask: Please schedule a public hearing on the sanctuary draft with interpretation in several languages.
actionable_reason: Requests public hearing with interpretation

subject: Meeting times
issue: The commission meetings are always at two in the afternoon on weekdays, so the people who actually live with the problems never get to speak.
detail: I work a shift until four, and by the time I could get there the agenda would be over.
ask: Please move at least some commission meetings to evenings or weekends so working families can attend.
actionable_reason: Requests evening or weekend commission meetings

subject: Appointments
issue: Every time the council fills a commission seat it seems to go to someone who has already donated to a campaign.
ask: Please publish the applicant list and donor disclosures before any appointment vote.
actionable_reason: Publish applicants and donor disclosures

subject: Juntas de la ciudad
issue: Las reuniones de las comisiones son entre semana por la tarde y yo trabajo en la construcción, así que nunca puedo ir a hablar.
detail: Mi esposa tampoco puede faltar a su trabajo y nadie nos avisó que había intérprete en español.
ask: Les pido que pongan intérpretes en las reuniones y que las hagan en horario de noche.
actionable_reason: Pide intérpretes y reuniones nocturnas

subject: Commission seats for shops
issue: As a small business owner, I'd like to see at least one seat on each commission filled by someone who runs a shop on the older commercial strip.
detail: The current members are mostly from large developers and big firms, and small shops keep getting left out of decisions.
Our voices should count too.
ask: Please require that at least one seat on each commission goes to a small business representative.
actionable_reason: Requests small business seat on commissions

subject: Interpreters
issue: Meetings have no interpreter for Vietnamese, so my parents sit in the back and cannot follow what is happening.
ask: Please provide interpretation in Vietnamese and Spanish at every commission meeting.
actionable_reason: Requests interpretation at all commission meetings

subject: Họp ngoài giờ hành chính
issue: Các buổi họp của ủy ban luôn diễn ra vào buổi chiều giờ hành chính nên người đi làm như tôi không thể tham dự.
detail: Tôi muốn phát biểu về vấn đề đường phố nhưng phải xin nghỉ việc, và tôi không đủ tiền để mất một ngày lương.
ask: Xin thành phố tổ chức họp ủy ban vào buổi tối hoặc cuối tuần để người lao động có thể tham gia.
actionable_reason: Cần họp ủy ban ngoài giờ hành chính

subject: Who gets appointed
issue: Almost everyone appointed to the planning board seems to be a homeowner who has lived in the same place for decades.
detail: Many residents rent, but nobody on the board has ever lived in an apartment like mine.
ask: Please appoint a renter and a younger worker to the next open seat on the planning board.
actionable_reason: Requests renter appointment to open seat

subject: Stipend for commissioners
issue: I support paying a small stipend to commission members so that people who work hourly jobs can still afford to serve.
detail: Right now only retirees and people with savings can sit on these boards, and that does not reflect the city.
A modest stipend is a small line in the budget compared to the consultants we already pay.
ask: Please add a commission stipend to the next budget and tie it to attendance.
actionable_reason: Stipend for commission members in next budget

subject: Agendas
issue: They post the meeting agenda a day before and then vote on things nobody had a chance to read.
ask: Please post agendas at least a week ahead and include plain-language summaries.
actionable_reason: Requests earlier agendas with plain summaries

subject: Term limits
issue: I oppose term limits on commissions, because the people who have done this work for years know what the projects need.
detail: Experience matters, but we should also have open seats every year so new people can apply.
ask: Please keep current term lengths and open every seat to public applications at least once a year.
actionable_reason: Keep term lengths; open seats to applications

subject: Vivienda sin nosotros
issue: En la comisión de vivienda no hay nadie que viva como nosotros, todos llevan años con casa propia.
ask: Les pido que publiquen las vacantes y acepten solicitudes de cualquier persona de la ciudad.
actionable_reason: Pide publicar vacantes y aceptar solicitudes

subject: Thành viên ủy ban
issue: Các thành viên ủy ban đều là người có tiếng tăm, còn những người thường như chúng tôi không biết làm sao để ứng cử.
ask: Xin thành phố công bố cách nộp đơn và tiêu chí chọn người rõ ràng cho mọi người.
actionable_reason: Cần công bố cách nộp đơn

subject: Advisory group
issue: I was on a city advisory group that rarely met, and our recommendations went nowhere.
detail: They gave us a deadline and then cancelled the meetings twice without notice.
ask: Please require commissions to publish how they responded to each public recommendation.
actionable_reason: Requires public responses to recommendations

subject: Recording meetings
issue: Meetings should be recorded and posted online so people who cannot come still know what was decided.
detail: My mom is a caregiver and cannot leave the house in the afternoon, but she follows city news closely on the radio.
We should not need to attend in person to hold the council accountable.
ask: Please record every commission meeting and post the video within 48 hours.
actionable_reason: Requests recording and posting within 48 hours

subject: Childcare at meetings
issue: I cannot bring my toddler to a commission meeting and nobody offers childcare, so I just stay home.
detail: Two other parents on my floor gave up on speaking at all for the same reason.
ask: Please provide childcare or a kids' room at commission meetings held in the evening.
actionable_reason: Requests childcare during commission meetings

subject: Keep the two-thirds rule
issue: I oppose lowering the voter threshold for local taxes, because a simple majority could raise our property taxes without enough input.
ask: Please keep the two-thirds requirement for local tax measures and do not put a lower threshold on the ballot.
actionable_reason: Keep two-thirds vote for local taxes

subject: Lower threshold
issue: I support a lower voter threshold for local public safety and parks funding, because the current two-thirds rule keeps good measures from passing.
ask: Please put a majority-vote measure on the ballot for public safety funding.
actionable_reason: Majority-vote measure for public safety funding

subject: Impuesto a la propiedad
issue: No estoy de acuerdo con bajar el requisito de votos para aprobar impuestos locales, porque ya pagamos demasiado en la casa.
detail: Cada año sube la cuenta de impuestos sin que nadie nos pregunte, y nosotros somos los que pagamos.
ask: Les pido que voten en contra de cualquier medida que baje el requisito de dos tercios.
actionable_reason: Votar contra bajar requisito de dos tercios

subject: Oppose workarounds
issue: I want the council to oppose any local measure that tries to get around the property tax limits that have kept my taxes predictable.
ask: Please take a stand against any local property tax measure that uses a loophole around the state limits.
actionable_reason: Oppose local tax measures that bypass limits

subject: Renters and the tax
issue: Renters pay property taxes through rent, so a higher local tax would hit us too.
detail: Landlords have already said they will pass any tax increase straight to tenants.
ask: Please require a rent impact analysis before the council puts a new local tax on the ballot.
actionable_reason: Requires rent impact analysis before ballot

subject: Vacancy tax
issue: I support a new local tax on vacant units owned by large companies, since they are not paying their share.
ask: Please put a vacancy tax measure on the ballot with a simple majority threshold.
actionable_reason: Vacancy tax measure with majority threshold

subject: Thuế tài sản
issue: Tôi không đồng ý tăng thuế địa phương vì thuế nhà đất ở đây đã cao hơn nhiều năm trước.
detail: Gia đình tôi đang dành dụm để trả nợ, và mỗi lần có thông báo tăng thuế là lại lo lắng.
ask: Xin hội đồng bỏ phiếu chống bất kỳ đề xuất nào làm giảm ngưỡng bỏ phiếu.
actionable_reason: Phản đối đề xuất giảm ngưỡng bỏ phiếu

subject: Affordable housing tax
issue: I'm in favor of a local tax for affordable housing, but only if voters can approve it with a simple majority.
detail: Renters feel every rent increase, and nobody in the council has really talked about that.
If the money actually brings rent down, I would vote yes.
ask: Please let voters decide an affordable housing tax by simple majority next year.
actionable_reason: Affordable housing tax with majority threshold

subject: Majority votes
issue: The two-thirds rule is too high for the things we actually need, and it keeps the same few projects stuck for years.
ask: Please support a state-level change that lets cities pass public safety taxes by majority vote.
actionable_reason: Requests state change for majority tax votes

subject: Rent stabilization first
issue: I am against any tax measure that puts the cost on renters without a rent cap, because that just passes the bill to the people who can least afford it.
detail: Our building has already had two rent hikes this year, and the owner says the property taxes are the reason.
A rent cap would protect us more than any tax credit.
ask: Please vote no on any ballot tax measure unless it comes with a rent stabilization provision.
actionable_reason: Opposes tax measures without rent stabilization

subject: Special election
issue: I think vacant council seats should be filled by a special election, because appointments let the council pick its own colleagues without voters.
detail: When the last seat opened, the appointment process took months and most of us never heard about the applicants.
ask: Please schedule a special election for the vacant seat rather than appointing a replacement.
actionable_reason: Special election for vacant seat requested

subject: Appoint and move on
issue: Honestly, appointing someone is faster and saves the city money, and I'd rather have a qualified person in the seat now.
ask: Please appoint a qualified replacement now and skip the cost of a special election.
actionable_reason: Appoint now, skip special election cost

subject: Elección especial
issue: Creo que cuando se vacía un lugar en el concejo debe haber una elección especial, porque la gente de aquí merece escoger a su representante.
detail: Cuando el lugar se llenó sin votación, mucha gente sintió que las decisiones ya estaban hechas.
Eso no debe repetirse en nuestra ciudad.
ask: Les pido que pongan la elección especial en la boleta antes de nombrar a alguien.
actionable_reason: Elección especial antes de nombrar reemplazo

subject: Transparency for appointments
issue: As a business owner, I want the appointment process to be published line by line, with each council member's vote and reasons recorded.
detail: Right now we hear results after the fact, and it is hard to hold anyone accountable.
ask: Please require that every appointment vote and its reasons be posted online the same day.
actionable_reason: Requires same-day posting of appointment votes

subject: Name the candidates
issue: Before any vote happens, the council should say out loud who it is considering for the seat.
ask: Please hold a public interview for each candidate before the council votes on a replacement.
actionable_reason: Public interviews before replacement vote

subject: Chọn người vào ghế trống
issue: Ghế trống trong hội đồng nên được bầu lại, vì tôi không biết ai được chọn và tại sao.
detail: Gia đình tôi sống ở đây đã lâu nhưng chưa bao giờ được hỏi ý kiến về người thay thế.
ask: Xin thành phố tổ chức bầu cử đặc biệt cho ghế trống để người dân có tiếng nói.
actionable_reason: Cần bầu cử đặc biệt cho ghế

subject: Against a special election
issue: I oppose a special election for the vacant seat, because a campaign costs too much and turnout would be low anyway.
detail: Turnout for these off-cycle races is usually a few percent, so a small group would decide who represents the whole district.
We would be paying for an election that the council could fill much more cheaply.
ask: Please appoint a qualified interim member this month and save the special election money.
actionable_reason: Appoint interim member; avoid special election cost

subject: Who decides
issue: The council should not be picking its own replacement, because that is how the same people stay in power for years.
ask: Please put the appointment rules up for public comment before the next vacancy.
actionable_reason: Public comment on appointment rules requested

subject: What it costs
issue: We pay council salaries and staff for a reason, and I expect the council to pick the option with the lowest cost to taxpayers.
detail: The last vacancy cost several thousand dollars in staff time, and nobody published the breakdown.
ask: Please publish the cost estimate for both the appointment process and any special election.
actionable_reason: Publish cost estimates for both options

subject: Closed sessions
issue: I want the council to keep its appointment record open for review, so voters can see how each member voted on the replacement and why.
detail: If the decision is hidden behind a closed session, the public loses trust in the process.
Most residents I talk to feel the same way.
ask: Please ban closed-session votes on council vacancies.
actionable_reason: Bans closed-session votes on vacancies
